acceptance_criteria.criterion: A new numbered constraint exists in constraints.md describing the cross-WP dispatch requirement for non-PM handoff functions
The constraint follows the established entry format (Rule, Rationale, and any applicable patterns)
findNextReadyDispatch() is listed in the workflow-handoff.ts internals section of api-surface.md with its full TypeScript signature and a brief algorithm description
Both files maintain consistent formatting with their existing entries

summary: Added Constraint 55 to constraints.md documenting the cross-WP dispatch requirement for the five non-PM handoff functions (getQaHandoff, getSecurityAuditorHandoff, getReviewerHandoff, getReleaseEngineerHandoff, getDocumentationHandoff). The constraint follows the established entry format with Rule, Rationale, algorithm description, and correct/anti patterns.

Added findNextReadyDispatch() to the workflow-handoff.ts internals section of api-surface.md with its full TypeScript signature, complete algorithm description (Steps 1–3 / null return), and dependency listing. Entry placed at the top of the internals block, before the per-role handoff function stubs, since it is a shared helper.
Updated the getQaHandoff, getReviewerHandoff, and getDocumentationHandoff stubs in api-surface.md to document the new cross-WP dispatch step (Step 6/5) referencing Constraint 55.

Added previously undocumented getSecurityAuditorHandoff and getReleaseEngineerHandoff stubs to the api-surface.md internals section, each including the cross-WP dispatch step and, for getReleaseEngineerHandoff, a note explaining the all-terminal scope asymmetry (releaseWps.every vs wpDetails.every) and how findNextReadyDispatch serves as the safety net for zero-release-stage projects.
Ran ctx generate — all context files regenerated successfully.

comments.note: getSecurityAuditorHandoff and getReleaseEngineerHandoff were entirely absent from the workflow-handoff.ts internals section of api-surface.md prior to this WP. Both were added with full stubs and cross-WP dispatch documentation, closing a documentation gap for these two roles.

[documentation-forward addressed] The Reviewer's documentation-forward item (getReleaseEngineerHandoff all-terminal early-exit asymmetry) was already addressed in WP-003's documentation pipeline via a design note in handoff.md. The getReleaseEngineerHandoff stub in api-surface.md now also includes a NOTE explaining the releaseWps.every() scope and the safety-net role of findNextReadyDispatch for zero-release-stage projects.

Constraint 55 explicitly documents that cross-WP dispatch is a best-effort optimization for IDE runners (the orchestrator does not depend on it), preventing future contributors from adding orchestrator-side dependencies on this behavior.
